title: An admitted acceptance evaluation cannot commit and then fail the agent response budget
outcome: An admitted acceptance evaluation cannot commit and then fail the agent response budget
acceptance: a service test records a maximal admitted evaluation and still receives a WorkEvaluateResult under the 12 KiB agent protocol limit
the evaluation object has an explicit canonical byte cap enforced before insert, refusing with nothing appended, and WorkEvaluateResult carries a bounded projection instead of the full record

completion.summary: An admitted evaluation never commits into a failed response: explicit documented admission bounds (1 MiB object cap, 256-byte source basis fields, 128-byte model segments, 256-byte attempt key) refused before any write, a bounded WorkEvaluationProjection with exact verdicts_total/verdicts_omitted preflighted against the real envelope before the commit, receipt and ordinary show fitted by explicit omission, and `show REF --full` returning the complete newest evaluation. Regression tests many_short_criteria_return_a_bounded_result_with_exact_omissions, a_large_blocking_criterion_and_a_large_rationale_still_fit, oversized_evaluations_are_refused_with_nothing_appended, and the verbs many-criteria receipt/show test pass; RED and GREEN logs retained. Focused checks recorded here; parent gates and the review pair on the final input remain the review parent's.
